ES.en: Monday 09-28 cycle. Freshly-born bullish thesis (Friday), day 1 -- it broke the 1-day bearish thesis with the cycle's best day, exiting the 7767.65-7787.49 indecision range. Conflicto de marco sigue abierto (sensor diario propio -3, rezagado). Vigilar el retroceso a la zona reclamada 51844-51940 o la extension directa sobre el maximo 52223. YM.en: Monday 09-28 cycle. A 1-day bullish thesis, the complex's cleanest and most resolved Friday -- it demolished its own invalidation (51844) with zero giveback. Frame conflict still open (own daily sensor -3, lagging). Watch the pullback to the reclaimed 51844-51940 zone or a direct extension above the 52223 high. Medium conviction despite the strength shown, per the 1-day thesis rule.

CL.en: Monday 09-28 cycle. A 4-day bearish reset, day 1 confirmed Friday with a new 91.51 low and no real bounce. Open frame conflict (fused daily/weekly +3/+3, lagging) and IG's weekend gap (+1.29%) is the only weekend reading with a real tilt, pointing the opposite way -- watch whether the reopen confirms it. No catalyst of its own until Wednesday's EIA.
